name: Hogan's Alley FC
blurb: A memorial / Afrofuturist heritage kit for the Black neighbourhood Vancouver paved over — and the block coming home. A tribute, not ownership: credit + proceeds route to the Hogan’s Alley Society and Ethọ́s Lab; shown to the community for their blessing before anything public or sold.

stages.title: The Mood
stages.blurb: Moodboards — the texture, palette and references the kit grows from.

images.caption: Moodboard close-up of draped indigo knit fabric flecked with gold, catching a violet sheen on wood.

Aged sepia architectural blueprint sheet showing a land-trust site plan and rows of building floor plans.
Ornate gold engraving of a brass jazz trumpet framed by deco filigree on deep indigo paper.
Draped indigo fabric with tonal woven constellation motifs and a gold braided trim edge.

stages.title: The Marks
stages.blurb: Crests, patterns, nameplates, numbers and typography — the language of the kit.

images.caption: Gold-and-indigo art-deco shield crest with a brass jazz horn, rising star, sunburst, and stylized buildings above a STILL HERE banner, foil-printed on bone paper.
Large gold number 71 filled with a Strathcona street-grid map pattern on a deep indigo jersey fabric.
Gold serif HOGAN'S ALLEY nameplate stitched onto a deep indigo jersey panel resting on wood.
Polished brass honour bar pin reading BLACK CULTURAL CENTRE on deep cosmic-indigo velvet.
Gold embroidered honour-bar patch reading COMMUNITY LAND TRUST on a star-flecked indigo ground.
Gold woven honour-bar patch reading THE BLOCK COMES HOME stitched to a flecked indigo fabric.
Bone-colored woven hem tag with gold STILL BUILDING lettering sewn to natural fabric.
Gold line-art brass jazz horn standing on a plinth inside a double circle, set against a cosmic indigo starfield.
